name: obsidian-finance
description: Optional folder-grounded equity, quarterly market research, and standalone stock technical analysis with on-demand SEC evidence acquisition, source cutoffs and protected checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: SEC evidence, equities, market research and technical analysis
interface.longDescription: Use equity-research-us to start or continue quarterly research on U.S.-listed companies in managed version-1 equities folders, preserving reports and edits and acquiring source-linked SEC evidence when required. Use industry-research for quarterly Obsidian market studies and their source-linked continuation. Live SEC acquisition uses a genuine contact saved locally after first-use setup. Offline research can reuse existing evidence without a contact. Use technical-analysis for dated technical outlooks from latest or local U.S. stock daily bars. Offline technical analysis uses Python 3.11+ and the standard library. Live price fetching uses isolated optional dependencies. Evidence gaps are reported explicitly.
defaultPrompt: Continue research in my designated managed equities folder at my specified assessment cutoff; discover required work, preserve prior reports and edits, and report evidence gaps and conditional horizon judgments.
